evals.prompt: can u check the security of my receipt-vault app before i push it public? its at ~/Documents/claude/projects/receipt-vault, its a next.js app using firebase auth + cloudinary for image uploads
evals.expected_output: Filled 16-item checklist in the three original categories. Should catch the hardcoded Firebase apiKey in lib/config.js on item 5, but reason about whether it's actually a problem (Firebase client keys are meant to be public) rather than flatly failing it. expectations: Output covers all 16 checklist items under the three original headings: Frontend Security, Backend Security, Practical Security Habits

Item 15 (file upload security) flags the unsigned Cloudinary upload preset / lack of server-side upload validation
Response ends with a caveat that this is a heuristic/static scan and not a substitute for a professional pentest or tools like CodeQL/Semgrep
Each checklist row has a one-line evidence note (file:line or explicit reason), not a paragraph-length essay per row
